title: Hide done items from list by default
lead:
`slicer list` returns every item, done included. On a mature roadmap that is
most of the queue, so the command meant to show the work still ahead is
dominated by finished rows. The TUI already hides the configured done status
(`Filters.initial` in `src/slicer/tui.py`, ~line 425). The CLI default should
match before 1.0 freezes what `list` and `list --json` return. Agents are told
to inspect the roadmap with `slicer list --json` (`src/slicer/ai.py`).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the TUI, which already omits the done status; `find`, `stats`, `status`, `next`, and the rendered roadmap, which keep showing finished items.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
A person scanning the queue and an agent parsing the JSON array both need the
work that is still ahead. Finished items stay reachable when asked for.
Shipping the old default in 1.0 would freeze a breaking change for later.
Parked, later, started, and retired items are still in play, so they stay
visible. S06 (publish to PyPI) depends on this item so the new default is in
place before that publish.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` — `cmd_list` (~line 356) and the `list` parser (~lines 1009-1013)
- `README.md` — the `list` row in the command table (~line 117)
- `docs/agents.md` — the `list` payload row (~line 127)
- `src/slicer/ai.py` — the `slicer list --json` instruction (~line 54)
- `tests/test_cli.py` — `test_List_JsonFlag_EmitsParsableJson` (mini fixture S01 is done)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. With a done item and an open item, `list` and `list --json` omit the done
   item and still show parked, later, and started items. Exit 0.
2. `list --all` and `list --all --json` include the done item. `--tree`,
   `--pass`, and `--sort score` still apply on top of `--all`.
3. `list --status done` includes the done item. Repeatable `--status` stays an
   allow-list, so `--status open` does not require `--all`.
4. `list --all --status done` exits 2 with `code="usage"`.
5. `test_List_JsonFlag_EmitsParsableJson` is updated: default `list --json` on
   the mini fixture omits done S01; `--all` returns S01–S04.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
In `cmd_list`, when `--status` is absent and `--all` is absent, drop items
whose status is `state.config.done_status`. Do not hardcode the status string.
`--status` keeps its current meaning (repeatable allow-list) and replaces that
default, so `--status done` shows finished items on this project. `--all` turns
the default exclusion off and is mutually exclusive with `--status`; reject
both together as a usage error before any filtering. Text and `--json` use the
same item set. An empty match still prints `no matching items` and exits 0.

Document the default in the `list` help, the README command row, the agents.md
payload row, and the agent instructions: finished items are omitted unless
`--all` is set or `--status` names them. `slicer list --sort score` follows
the same default.

Update `test_List_JsonFlag_EmitsParsableJson` so a default list does not expect
done S01. Tests that compare two `list` invocations to each other
(`tests/test_sort.py`) can stay. `find` keeps returning done items;
`tests/test_find.py` only requires that every default list row appear in find
output, which holds while find is the wider set.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
`slicer list` on this repo omits done rows; `slicer list --all` and
`slicer list --status done` show them; `slicer list --status open` still shows
only open. `slicer check` passes.
